proposal.title: finite graph authority reservation — case 5
proposal.hypothesis: A consequential graph publication, deployment, identity, legal, cultural, Maori-authority, or Stage 20 action remains unexecuted without exact authority.
proposal.null_or_failure_condition: Unknown or missing fields, invalid node or edge references, nondeterministic ordering, input mutation, failed round trip, external action, or protected-claim promotion is a failed subject with zero success credit.
proposal.falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: Require a closed deterministic result, unchanged input, exact property witness, retained invalid subject, no external action, and unchanged evidence and authority ceilings.
proposal.rollback_or_recovery: Retain the failed subject, stop selecting only the failed operation, repair the smallest dependency, and preserve every earlier witness.

value.required: fresh action-specific competent and affected authority
